text:
According to the onboarding guide, Hermes Agent already provides an interactive setup wizard for messaging channels. 

You can configure Discord without manual file edits by running:

```bash
hermes gateway setup
```

This launches the interactive platform setup wizard step-by-step for Discord, Telegram, and other supported messaging platforms. 

To validate your configuration and environment after setup, you can also run:
```bash
hermes doctor
```
